subject: Request: LumosChain HackDay - community credits + trial extension
messages:
From: Sana Gupta <sana@lumos.org>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: LumosChain HackDay - request for credits & extension

Hi Ava,

Hope you're well — I'm Sana, program lead at LumosChain Foundation. We're running LumosChain HackDay (Dec 10-12) with ~75 community maintainers and mentors across web3 infra projects. Our timeline shifted and a number of projects asked if we could get more compute and a short trial extension so contributors can finish builds and demos.

Specifically, could Redwood support us with: 
- 40,000 developer credits (for CI/builds + demo runs)
- A 3-month trial extension on top of the standard promo for the org so maintainers can onboard after the event

We believe this will meaningfully increase uptake and produce demo-ready workloads (and public case studies) that highlight Redwood's serving performance. We can add Redwood to our sponsor page, promote a joint blog post, and include Redwood in the mentors lightning session.

I've attached a short requirements doc with expected runner metrics and a list of lead maintainers. Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to review details.

Thanks — Sana
Sana Gupta
Program Lead, LumosChain Foundation
contact@lumos.org
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-03T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: LumosChain HackDay - request for credits & extension

Marissa, Vivek — forwarding LumosChain's ask. TL;DR: 40k credits + 3-month org-level trial extension. Event Dec 10-12, ~75 maintainers. They can commit to sponsor visibility and a follow-up case study.

My thoughts: we probably don't want to do full 40k without approvals; could we do 30k + promo code for additional 10k if they hit the mentor/demo KPIs? Vivek — can finance/partner ops create a voucher and promo code if approved?

I attached their requirements doc.

Ava — thanks for flagging. I'm supportive of a community-first approach here. Approve the following:
- 40,000 community credits allocated to LumosChain org (use a restricted voucher tied to project IDs)
- 3-month trial extension at org level (starts from the date we activate the voucher)
- Requirement: LumosChain provides sponsor acknowledgement, logo on event page, and a short case study within 90 days of event.

Vivek — please generate the voucher and a one-time promo code. I'll sign off on any legal/marketing asks. I've attached the approved_credit_matrix.csv for records.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head, Community Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sana Gupta <sana@lumos.org>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-05T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: LumosChain voucher and promo code (Redwood)

Hi Sana — looping you in with the delivery details. Per Marissa's approval we've created: 
- Voucher: LUMOS-HACKDAY-2026 (40,000 credits; restricted to org/project IDs in the attached voucher PDF)
- Promo code: LUMOS-DEMO-10K (one-time top-up of 10,000 credits; redeemable during event window)
- Trial extension: 3 months (applies when voucher is redeemed)

Attachments: voucher_lumos_20261105.pdf (voucher details & activation steps), lumos_promo_code.txt (promo code), approved_credit_matrix.csv (internal record).

Also shared a DocuSign sponsorship acknowledgement for their marketing team: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-lumos

If you need an invoice or formal SOW for bookkeeping, Sana, let us know and I can loop finance.

Best,
Vivek
Partner Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Sana Gupta <sana@lumos.org>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LumosChain voucher and promo code (Redwood)

Amazing — thank you all, this is perfect. We've received the voucher PDF and promo code file. I'll route the DocuSign to our marketing lead and confirm the sponsor page copy by EOD next week.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood can provide a single-line invoice for the credits (for our records/sponsorship budget)? If so, please send to finance@lumos.org and cc me.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — excited to get maintainers onto Redwood for the demos.

— Sana
